en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town nestled against a steep mountain backdrop. In the center stands a prominent church with a tall bell tower rising above clustered houses. In the foreground, a metal truss bridge crosses a river lined with stone embankments. The caption printed at the top right reads "Pilaonte (Trentino) - Panorama" (the first word slightly unclear but legible as a place name). The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
